mlPipeline.title: ML Pipeline (dev)
mlPipeline.description: Retraining loop cockpit: gather training data for model gaps, upload the dataset to S3, dispatch the cloud retrain workflow.
mlPipeline.gatherWarning: The gather script kills and restarts Dota 2 repeatedly and controls the mouse and keyboard for ~40 minutes. It opens in its own console window — press Ctrl+C there to abort.
mlPipeline.dryRunRunning: Dry run in progress — can take several minutes if slot metadata needs a Liquipedia scrape (31s per hero page)…
mlPipeline.gatherConfirm: This will take over your PC (mouse, keyboard, Dota 2 restarts) for about 40 minutes. Continue?
mlPipeline.dryRunDone: Dry run complete — review the plan below (watch for MISSING METADATA).
mlPipeline.gatherLaunched: Gather script launched in a separate console window.
mlPipeline.heroGatherDescription: Re-collect ALL abilities of the selected heroes — for icon reworks where ability names stay the same. Free lobby slots are auto-filled with the least-trained heroes, which get gathered too.
mlPipeline.heroPurgeLabel: Purge existing images first (moved to _purged/, not deleted — old icons would poison the reworked classes)
mlPipeline.heroGatherPurgeConfirm: Existing dataset images of the selected heroes will be moved to _purged/ before gathering.
mlPipeline.modelsGatherDescription: Collect draft-board hero MODEL tile images for every known hero (including new ones) until each has the target number, across rotated board positions. Crops feed the app's model-tile recognition library directly. Resumable — interrupting loses nothing.
mlPipeline.diagnosticDescription: Run full bot drafts cycling through the hero roster, recording pool, pick, model-tile and OCR recognition against known ground truth. Analyze afterwards to get an HTML report of what failed and why.
mlPipeline.diagnosticKeepAppOpen: Keep this app running with the overlay activated and experimental auto-rescan enabled for the whole run — it records the scan data the analyzer needs.
mlPipeline.diagnosticAnalyzed: Report generated and opened in your browser.
mlPipeline.diagnosticConfirm: This will repeatedly restart Dota 2 and run full bot drafts (~6-10 minutes each). The app must stay running. Continue?
mlPipeline.uploadStep: 2. Upload dataset to S3 (after seeding splits for new classes)
mlPipeline.uploadLaunched: Upload launched in a separate console window — note the dataset version it prints.
mlPipeline.retrainDispatched: Workflow dispatched for dataset v{{version}} — check the GitHub Actions tab. A PR with the new model and metrics will open when the gate passes.
